title: Trump's FAKE Credit Card Interest Rate Cap Is ALL TALK
text: Trump's FAKE Credit Card Interest Rate Cap Is ALL TALKPresident Trump has promised to cap interest rates on credit cards but has yet to move on getting the legislation passed. Ana Kasparian discusses on The Young Turks. Do you agree with TYT's take? Tell us what you think in the comments below.
